The late gospel singer, Bayonle Olayemi, known as Toluwanisings, is being laid to rest today as the program is ongoing.
The funeral arrangement details shared by the family on his Instagram page read, “Forever in our hearts, always on our lives. Monday, 9th November, 2026. Lying in state: 9am – 10am. Burial service: 10am – 11 am. Venue – Ibadan.”
The venue listed in the announcement is Banjola Event and Conference Centre in Alakia, Ibadan, Oyo State.
The Cable social media showed the vehicle that carried his remains entering the premises of the event center.
According to BBC Yoruba, journalists were not allowed onto the premises of the venue.
Toluwanisings died on October 14, 2026. His passing drew an outpouring of grief from fans, fellow ministers of the gospel, and members of the music industry who had followed his ministry and celebrated his contributions to worship music.
After much disagreement on the plan and location for burying the gospel singer, the family has reached a compromise to bury the singer on his home premises.
